Kildare County Council reminds 
landowners and occupiers of 
nesting season obligations 
 
Kildare County Council remind 
landowners and occupiers of the 
restrictions on cutting hedges and 
clearing vegetation on uncultivated 
lands from 01 March to 
31 August.  These restrictions are in 
place to protect nesting birds, as 
outlined in Section 40 of the Wildlife

(Amendment) Act 2000 and the 
Heritage Act 2018. 
Hedgerow cutting is permitted from 
September to February, when

Housing and Regeneration 
 
Housing 
Second Hand Acquisition 
Programme 2025 
Minister Browne has announced €325 
million in funding for a secondhand 
acquisition programme in 2025.  
Priority categories for funding are: 
• Tenant in Situ 
• Older Persons and Persons 
with a Disability 
• Exits from Homeless Services 
• Buy and Renew which tackles 
vacancy 
 
In terms of the Tenant in Situ local 
authorities are required to prioritise 
acquisitions for families with children, 
older persons or people with a 
disability who are at serious risk of 
homelessness where a valid notice of 
termination has been issued due to the 
landlord’s intention to sell.  Properties 
may only be purchased in cases where 
a tenant has been in receipt of HAP or 
RAS support on the property for at 
least two years.  The council will not 
be entitled to claim any refurbishment 
costs on Tenant in Situ acquisitions. 
Properties included in the 2024 
acquisition programme where the sale 
did not conclude in the year will be 
funded from the 2025 Acquisition 
Programme. 
We are awaiting receipt of a circular 
detailing the specifics terms of the 
scheme and the council’s allocation 
under the scheme and will keep the 
Members updated.
